CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `mission_integrity_scores` (
  `id` INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `ventureId` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  `overallScore` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `financialVsMissionDrift` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `stakeholderAlignmentScore` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `governanceStrengthScore` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `leadershipContinuityScore` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `missionDriftTrend` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Stable',
  `lastAssessmentAt` TIMESTAMP NULL,
  `createdAt` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `constitutional_governance` (
  `id` INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `ventureId` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `founderVetoRights` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `founderVetoScope` TEXT,
  `boardSize` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 5,
  `founderSeats` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 2,
  `independentSeats` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `investorSeats` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 2,
  `missionAlignedSeats` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `employeeRepresentation` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `communityRepresentation` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `customerAdvisoryBoard` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `missionClauseInBylaws` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `missionClauseText` TEXT,
  `createdAt` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `succession_plans` (
  `id` INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `ventureId` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `successorsJson` JSON,
  `founderMissionStatement` TEXT,
  `founderNonNegotiables` TEXT,
  `founderTransitionTimeline` VARCHAR(50),
  `missionCodified` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `missionCodexText` TEXT,
  `decisionFrameworkDocumented` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `coreValuesDocumented` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `stakeholderRelationshipsDocumented` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `createdAt` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `stakeholder_profiles` (
  `id` INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `ventureId` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  `name` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  `category` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'investor',
  `influenceLevel` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',
  `missionAlignment` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'neutral',
  `engagementLevel` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'neutral',
  `interests` TEXT,
  `concerns` TEXT,
  `engagementStrategy` TEXT,
  `createdAt` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `mission_drift_alerts` (
  `id` INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `ventureId` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  `severity` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Medium',
  `category` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  `message` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `evidence` TEXT,
  `resolved` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `resolvedAt` TIMESTAMP NULL,
  `createdAt` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
